en.t: “I should not have a new romance.”

units.source_text: 町子一边自言自语，一边去爬铁梯子。

en.t: Machiko muttered to herself as she went to climb the iron ladder.

units.source_text: 在钢筋水泥墙外侧，有道楼梯从后台直伸到屋顶。

en.t: On the outside of the reinforced concrete wall, a stairway ran straight from backstage up to the roof.
